fields.label: Fieldname
fields.description: The fieldname on the governed doctype, exactly as it appears in the schema

fields.label: Requirement
fields.description: Blank inherits from the less specific scope. Only a stated value overrides

fields.label: Label
fields.description: What this institution calls the field. Blank keeps the schema label

fields.label: Display Order
fields.description: Zero means unstated, so a more specific scope may still set it

fields.label: Minimum Value
fields.description: Blank means no bound. Data rather than Float on purpose: a Float column is NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, so it could not tell a bound of zero from no bound at all

fields.label: Maximum Value
fields.description: Blank means no bound. Data rather than Float on purpose: a Float column is NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, so it could not tell a bound of zero from no bound at all
